title: 信息日报 2026-10-06

headline.title: OpenAI 将在欧盟为 ChatGPT 文本添加水印以符合 AI 法案
headline.summary: OpenAI 宣布将在欧盟为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 生成的文本添加水印，以遵守欧盟《人工智能法案》。水印为不可见标记，但用户编辑后可能更难被检测。该公司表示，检测工具将首先向研究人员开放。此举标志着 AI 内容溯源监管进入实操阶段。
headline.title_en: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
headline.summary_en: OpenAI will begin watermarking text generated by ChatGPT and Codex in the EU to comply with the AI Act. The watermarks are invisible, but editing can make them harder to detect, the company says. Detection tools will initially be available to researchers. OpenAI has outlined its approach to text provenance under EU rules, explaining where watermarks apply and how detection works. The move marks a practical step in AI content provenance regulation as the EU enforces its AI Act.
headline.original_title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
headline.reason: 这是 OpenAI 对欧盟《人工智能法案》的合规回应，影响 ChatGPT 在欧盟的文本输出，并推动 AI 内容溯源与检测技术发展，具有监管与行业示范意义。
headline.reason_en: This is OpenAI's compliance response to the EU AI Act, affecting ChatGPT text output in the EU and advancing AI content provenance and detection, with regulatory and industry significance.
